item.name: List sets and remember Library Basics

exec: pm.test('body.data is an array', function () { pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Library Basics is listed', function () { pm.expect(library).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('body.data is an array', function () { pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); });
const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('owner and cover are set', function () { pm.expect(body.owner_id).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.cover_url).to.eql(null); });

const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('default page envelope is valid', function () { pm.expect(body.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.meta.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.meta.limit).to.eql(10); pm.expect(body.meta.total).to.be.at.least(3); pm.expect(body.meta.pages).to.eql(Math.ceil(body.meta.total / body.meta.limit)); });

const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('page and limit are applied', function () { pm.expect(body.meta.page).to.eql(2); pm.expect(body.meta.limit).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.data).to.have.length(1); });

const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('search is case-insensitive', function () { pm.expect(body.data.every((set) => set.name.toLowerCase().includes('library'))).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.some((set) => set.name === 'Library Basics')).to.eql(true); });

const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('empty search has an empty envelope', function () { pm.expect(body.data).to.eql([]); pm.expect(body.meta.total).to.eql(0); pm.expect(body.meta.pages).to.eql(0); });
const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('percent is a literal search character', function () { pm.expect(body.meta.total).to.eql(0); });

const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('ids are strictly descending', function () { const ids = body.data.map((set) => set.id); pm.expect(ids.every((id, index) => index === 0 || ids[index - 1] > id)).to.eql(true); });

const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('seeded question choices and positions are loaded', function () { pm.expect(body.questions).to.have.length(5); body.questions.forEach((question, index) => { pm.expect(question.position).to.eql(index + 1); pm.expect(question.choices).to.have.length(4); pm.expect(question.choices.filter((choice) => choice.is_correct).length).to.eql(1); }); });

const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('position and choices are assigned', function () { pm.expect(body.position).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.choices.map((choice) => choice.choice_index)).to.eql([1, 2, 3, 4]); pm.expect(body.choices.filter((choice) => choice.is_correct).length).to.eql(1); });
const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('next position is assigned', function () { pm.expect(body.position).to.eql(2); });
const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('ownership error is clear', function () { pm.expect(body.error.message.toLowerCase()).to.include('another host'); });

const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('questions are ordered and include choices', function () { pm.expect(body.data).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(body.data.map((question) => question.position)).to.eql([1, 2]); pm.expect(body.meta.total).to.eql(2); pm.expect(body.data[0].choices).to.have.length(4); pm.expect(body.data[0].choices[0]).to.have.property('is_correct'); });
const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('question paging works', function () { pm.expect(body.data).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(body.meta.pages).to.eql(2); });
const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('text changed and choices stayed', function () { pm.expect(body.text).to.eql('Edited question text here?'); pm.expect(body.choices).to.have.length(4); });

const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('second choice is correct', function () { pm.expect(body.choices).to.have.length(4); pm.expect(body.choices[1].is_correct).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.choices.filter((choice) => choice.is_correct).length).to.eql(1); });
